Communication patterns for AUTOSAR services The com- munication patterns for AUTOSAR services are summarized in Table 11.1.

Communication patterns for AUTOSAR services I II III IV A 1..n PPort:RPort Distribution of data or modes to n software-components, e.g. used for ECU mode. A* 1..n RPort:PPort Currently not used, not supported for client-server communication. A** 1..n PRPort:RPort Distribution of data or modes to n software-components, e.g. used for ECU mode. B 1..1 PPort:RPort Software-component acts as Server, used for so called “call-backs”. B 1..1 RPort:PPort Service acts as Server, typical Service usage. C* n..1 PPort:RPort Conceptually not used to support index abstraction via PortDefinedArgumentValue s. C n..1 RPort:PPort Software-component acts as Server, used for so called “call-backs” invoked by more than one Service. D 1..1 PR- Port:PRPort I/O control data.
